purpose: Frozen context of use for the elite-soccer successor Loaded-CMJ Plant: reference population, task, evidence hierarchy and claim boundary.

decisions.statement: Sport-context identifier for the successor Plant reference population.
decisions.locator: Linear Elite Soccer System Authority V1 section 1; Bongiovanni 2023 cohort
decisions.notes: Synthetic population identifier; not a claim about any individual.

decisions.value: healthy senior adult male first-team professional outfield soccer player, top-tier European domestic league / UEFA-caliber environment; goalkeepers excluded; field position not frozen
decisions.locator: System authority section 1; S05 positional differences

decisions.value: maximal voluntary bilateral +20.0 kg back-loaded countermovement jump, hands fixed to the bar, no arm swing, dual-force-plate laboratory setting, full standing-countermovement-flight-landing-recovery sequence
decisions.locator: System authority section 1; loaded-CMJ task evidence

decisions.statement: Claim boundary of the V1 reduction.
decisions.value: sagittal-plane mechanics only; lateral translation, roll and yaw are structurally removed; no 3-D cutting/lateral/asymmetric validity claim
decisions.notes: Any materially asymmetric control claim requires a future true 3-D/6-DOF Plant.

decisions.value: 1 human anatomy/joint mechanics/BSIP; 2 elite senior male first-division soccer anthropometry; 3 elite/professional soccer CMJ testing evidence; 4 soccer +20 kg loaded-jump evidence supplemented by broader loaded-CMJ work; 5 NBA elite CMJ data as secondary strategy comparator; 6 engineering choices only where literature does not determine a unique value, always tagged and sensitivity-tested
decisions.locator: Linear RES-95 description; System authority section 2
decisions.notes: No engineering value may be relabeled as an elite-soccer measurement.

decisions.statement: Use of NBA CMJ cohort data.
decisions.value: secondary elite movement-strategy comparator only; it sets neither soccer anthropometry nor +20 kg performance thresholds

decisions.statement: Claim ceiling after the Plant rebuild (M6).
decisions.value: the Plant may be called a sagittal-dominant rigid-body model parameterized to a nominal elite senior male professional outfield soccer athlete and configured for a maximal 20 kg loaded countermovement jump; no subject-specific, population-norm, injury-risk, optimality, midfoot-fidelity or field/turf claim
